name: Dhanlaxmi Cotex Ltd
about:
Incorporated in Dhanlaxmi Cotex Ltd is in the business of investment and trading 
in Securities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is promoted by Dhanlaxmi Group which has experience in textiles & investments. It has its own weaving unit, yarn dyeing & a process house. Group used to lend money to companies as intercorporate deposits, bills 
discounting, promoters funding & equity investments in primary & secondary markets. It diversified into stock broking and acquired membership of BSE & NSE

pros: Stock is trading at 0.88 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 4.97% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.69 Cr.
